description: Post-Dhurandhar 2 forward arc for Hamza Ali Mazari / Jaskirat Singh Rangi. End of D2 leaves him exposed but operational; the arc projects his career across the 2025-12 → 2026-04 real-world events (Pahalgam aftermath, Operation Sindoor build-up, Khalistan diaspora pressure, ISI counter-intelligence sweeps in Karachi). Real-life inspiration (Mohit Sharma, KIA 2009) means death is a non-trivial absorbing state.
notes: Macro-actions are coarse career choices, not field tactics. Transition probabilities encode the real risk that a deep-cover operative does not survive a multi-year arc — terminal status 'killed' or 'blown' is always non-zero.

actions.label: Stay deep in Lyari
actions.description: Continue running the Karachi cover, exploit Dakait-successor PAC network, feed routine intel to RAW. Low-volatility default — exposure compounds slowly.

actions.label: Penetrate Major Iqbal's LeT control node
actions.description: Push from Lyari criminal layer into LeT operational layer — high-risk move on the ISI/LeT control structure that ran 26/11. Highest mission-yield action; highest mortality.

actions.label: Relocate to handle Punjab ops from Dubai/UAE
actions.description: Step out of direct cover; run Punjab narco-Khalistan ops as an offshore handler. Trades mission-yield ceiling for survivability and network reach.

actions.label: Pair with Rizwan Shah on Punjab ground op
actions.description: Stay in-theatre but shift role to operational mentor for the Film-2 successor. Compounds network durability via knowledge transfer; moderate yield.

actions.label: Lateral move to Canada / UK Khalistan diaspora
actions.description: Use established cover to penetrate diaspora Khalistan funding network (SFJ, BKI Canadian chapter). High strategic value but creates Nijjar-style attribution risk for India.

actions.label: Convert Pakistani locals into long-term RAW assets
actions.description: Spend 6+ months turning Lyari contacts into recruited assets. Slow yield but builds durable network India can run after Hamza is gone.

actions.label: Stage own death / disappearance
actions.description: Engineer a controlled cover-collapse that lets Hamza exit while preserving network. Trades active status for low-attribution exit and protected assets.

actions.label: Request immediate extraction
actions.description: End the field career; return to RAW HQ as analyst / trainer. Caps exposure but ends per-event mission yield.

actions.label: Author Naya Bharat asymmetric doctrine (post-extraction)
actions.description: Available only after extraction/retirement. Hamza becomes doctrinal author — multiplies strategic impact through institutional knowledge transfer.

events.label: Post-D2 canon close — operational continuity decision
events.description: End of film-2 canon. Hamza is exposed enough that the Punjab-Khanani-FICN operation has visibly disrupted ISI operations, but his Lyari cover is intact. Decision: continue field, pivot, or extract.

events.label: ISI counter-intelligence sweeps Karachi
events.description: Pattern of unexplained deaths of ISI-linked figures in Pakistan (real-world 2023-2025) intensifies; ISI runs aggressive CI sweeps through Lyari and PAC networks looking for foreign assets. Hamza must decide whether to harden cover, pivot offshore, or accept extraction.

events.label: Khalistan diaspora radicalisation surge
events.description: Happy PHD network and Canadian SFJ chapter escalate operational tempo — funding, social-media radicalisation, weapon-cache attempts in Punjab. RAW needs in-network eyes; Hamza is one of few operatives with the cover plausibility for Canada lateral.

events.label: Pahalgam attack — TRF kills civilians
events.description: TRF (LeT proxy) attacks tourists in Pahalgam, Kashmir. India enters retaliation-planning posture. Demand for in-Pakistan HUMINT on LeT control nodes spikes. High-yield, high-risk window opens for an operative with Lyari/Major Iqbal proximity.

events.label: Operation Sindoor planning window
events.description: India enters active planning for retaliatory cross-border strikes. Last operational window for in-theatre HUMINT before kinetic phase begins. Whatever Hamza does here is the final career move within the projection horizon.
